newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BCP results good, H2 seen strong.
newsitem.headline: BCP results good, H2 seen strong.

text.p: First half results of Banco Comercial Portugues (BCP) were good, supporting the shares around 3,450 escudos, and dealers said Portugal's biggest private bank was set to perform well in the second half.

"BCP's first half results were good, and I believe that the second half will also be strong, because BCP still has some areas where it could boost gains, as in the development of cross selling," a dealer said.
Shares of BCP varied between 3,415 and 3,458 escudos. BCP shares stood at 3,445 escudos, up 55, in volume of 329,942 at 1108 GMT.
The bank announced a 21 percent year-on-year increase in consolidated net first half profit to 13.121 billion escudos. BCP's non-consolidated profit rose 21 percent to about nine billion escudos.
